narrative_shape: The module rewrite is finished by T75 (10 edits, 2 writes). The visible story is waiting: a full-Australia extraction runs in the background (peak RSS about 4.1 GB), the worker reviews its own module while waiting (T68-69), arms and re-arms monitors (T88, one-hour window), and then does done-evidence checks, a full-suite pytest wait (T100-102) and commit of owned files (T105). Narration is large (3.4k->5.4k chars) but almost entirely status.

rationale: Authoring finished early; later activity is bounded waits on extraction and tests, ending in a clean commit. Waits are explicit and not looped.
